pressReleases.title: Niramaya BioDiagnostics Closes ₹375 Cr Series B to Deploy AI Liquid Biopsy Across 150 Hospital Networks in India
pressReleases.subtitle: Round led by Peak XV Partners with participation from Tata 1mg Founders Fund and Mayo Clinic Ventures.
pressReleases.author: Rajesh Malhotra
pressReleases.content:
NEW DELHI & BENGALURU — Niramaya BioDiagnostics, India’s pioneer in multi-omic AI diagnostic models for early-stage oncology, today announced the successful closing of its ₹375 Crore Series B financing round. The oversubscribed round was led by Peak XV Partners, with strategic participation from leading domestic healthcare syndicates and institutional investors.

The capital infusion will accelerate the national commercial rollout of Niramaya’s proprietary DeepBiomarker™ engine across 150+ hospital networks including AIIMS, Apollo Hospitals, Fortis, and Max Healthcare, reducing diagnostic turnaround from weeks to under 15 minutes.

"Every Indian patient deserves the power of early molecular detection before clinical symptoms manifest," said Dr. Alok Verma, Chief Scientific Officer of Niramaya BioDiagnostics. "With this capital, we make non-invasive genetic oncology screening accessible and affordable across Tier-1 and Tier-2 Indian cities."

Clinical trial data validated DeepBiomarker's 98.4% specificity rate, surpassing conventional tissue biopsy sensitivity by 34% in early Stage I and II carcinomas.
pressReleases.boilerplate:
About Niramaya BioDiagnostics:
Niramaya BioDiagnostics is an AI-powered biotechnology enterprise based in Bengaluru and New Delhi, transforming patient outcomes through rapid non-invasive genomic sequencing. The company collaborates with leading oncology centers across India.

pressReleases.title: BharatQuantum Demonstrates India’s First Room-Temperature Optical Interface for Cryogenic Quantum Processors
pressReleases.subtitle: Breakthrough photonics interconnect engineered in Bengaluru eliminates thermal cabling latency by 90%.
pressReleases.author: Priya Sengupta
pressReleases.content:
PUNE & AMRAVATI — BharatQuantum Systems Pvt. Ltd. today unveiled India's first room-temperature optical interconnect capable of interfacing directly with sub-Kelvin cryogenic quantum processing units (QPUs).

The breakthrough architectural module, dubbed Param-Link-X™, enables banking data centers and research labs to cluster multiple quantum cores without thermal leakage or cryogenic vacuum loss.

"Until today, quantum processors remained isolated lab experiments," said Dr. Meera Nambiar, Founder & CEO of BharatQuantum. "Param-Link-X transforms quantum computing into a scalable, high-throughput compute fabric designed for India's digital economy."
pressReleases.boilerplate:
About BharatQuantum Systems:
BharatQuantum Systems develops modular, fault-tolerant quantum computing hardware for financial risk modeling, drug discovery, and national cybersecurity infrastructure.

pressReleases.title: Garuda Robotics Deploys 500th Humanoid Unit Across Major Indian Automotive Assembly Lines
pressReleases.subtitle: Indigenous industrial humanoids surpass 1,000,000 incident-free component handling cycles in Pune gigafactories.
pressReleases.author: Priya Sengupta
pressReleases.content:
PUNE & NASHIK — Garuda Robotics India today announced a watershed industrial milestone with the deployment of its 500th autonomous humanoid robot across top-tier automotive manufacturing assembly lines.

Operating on Garuda's proprietary NeuralGait 4.0 spatial intelligence system, the humanoid fleet has logged over one million consecutive heavy-component transport cycles with a zero-incident safety record and 99.98% operational uptime.

About Garuda Robotics India:
Garuda Robotics builds heavy-payload, collaborative humanoid systems engineered specifically for complex Indian industrial manufacturing and warehousing environments.

pressReleases.title: Prithvi Clean Energy Breaks Ground on 10GW Green Hydrogen Electrolyzer Facility in Kutch, Gujarat
pressReleases.subtitle: Mega project aligned with National Green Hydrogen Mission to export zero-emission green ammonia to Europe & Japan.
pressReleases.author: Rajesh Malhotra
pressReleases.content:
AHMEDABAD & PUNE — Prithvi Clean Energy Holdings today officially commenced construction of its 10-gigawatt (GW) integrated green hydrogen electrolyzer gigafactory in Kutch, Gujarat.

The facility represents an investment of ₹14,500 Crore and will utilize dedicated solar and wind power to produce 1.2 million metric tonnes of green ammonia annually by 2027.

blogPosts.title: The Indian Media Landscape: Navigating Tier-1 Business Dailies and Prime-Time Television
blogPosts.excerpt: An insider look into how newsrooms at The Economic Times, Mint, and CNBC-TV18 evaluate technology and financial scoops in the modern Indian digital economy.
blogPosts.summary: Understanding newsroom rhythms, embargo ethics, and on-record spokesperson guidelines in India’s hyper-competitive financial press corridors.
blogPosts.content:
Securing page-one editorial visibility in India requires far more than generic press releases. Modern business editors at publications like The Economic Times, Mint, and Business Standard sift through hundreds of pitches daily.

To capture genuine editorial attention, communications teams must follow three fundamental principles:

1. Macro Alignment with National Priorities: Whether it is the National Quantum Mission, semiconductor fabrication, or green hydrogen corridors, anchor your corporate milestone to broader national and economic inflection points.
2. Verified Data Integrity: Indian financial reporters demand verifiable unit economics, audited clinical data, or certified technical benchmarks. Claims lacking documentary backing are immediately discarded.
3. Spokesperson Agility: News cycles move rapidly across Amravati, Akola, Pune, and Nashik. Senior executives must be available for immediate on-record interviews with concise, jargon-free talking points.

blogPosts.title: SEBI Compliance & The Art of the Pre-IPO Tech Narrative in India
blogPosts.excerpt: Navigating publicity guidelines, quiet-period protocols, and anchor investor communications ahead of Dalal Street listings.
blogPosts.summary: A definitive guide for Indian founders and CFOs on managing media relations from DRHP filing through the NSE/BSE listing bell ceremony.
blogPosts.content:
Taking an Indian technology enterprise public is one of the most scrutinized milestones a founder will ever undertake. SEBI maintains rigorous regulations regarding public disclosures, forward-looking statements, and publicity during the DRHP review window.

Here is how mature leadership teams structure their communications:

• Unified Investor Relations & PR Alignment: Ensure all executive quotes mirror the exact disclosures filed in the Draft Red Herring Prospectus.
• Proactive Stakeholder Education: Demystify your unit economics and category tailwinds well before entering the formal quiet period.
• Listing Day Command: Orchestrate the BSE/NSE bell ceremony with multi-angle broadcast feeds and pre-cleared executive media schedules.

author.name: Vikram Singhania
author.title: Partner & Head of Capital Markets Comms

blogPosts.title: Crisis Communications War Room: The First 15 Minutes That Save Corporate Equity

blogPosts.content:
In the era of viral social media outrage and 24/7 television business debates, an unaddressed crisis can erase hundreds of crores in enterprise valuation within hours.

The GSRelation Crisis War Room Protocol consists of:

1. Instant Fact Triage: Mobilize legal, communications, and executive leadership within 15 minutes to establish uncontested facts.
2. Holding Statement Deployment: Release a calm, empathetic, and factual statement acknowledging the situation while audits are underway.
3. Direct Stakeholder Briefings: Engage key institutional investors, regulators, and customers before speculative reporting takes root.
